title: BPSC TRE 3.0 PGT Computer Science (Practice Set — Syllabus & Topic-Weightage Aligned)
note: Pattern (Language qualifying + GS + Subject, 150 Q / 150 marks / 150 min / no negative marking) is corroborated across multiple 2026 sources. One source cites 220 Q for the actual 2024 TRE 3.0 paper instead — verify against the official BPSC notification before treating either figure as final. Questions below are original practice items aligned to verified topic-weightage, not verbatim reproductions of the real paper.

sections.name: Language (Qualifying)
sections.note: Qualifying only, not added to merit — recommend excluding from scored totals in your app

questions.question: Who led the Revolt of 1857 in Bihar?
questions.explanation: Veer Kunwar Singh of Jagdishpur led the 1857 rebellion in Bihar.

questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
questions.explanation: The Kosi river's frequent, destructive course changes and flooding earned it this name.

questions.question: Article 370 of the Indian Constitution dealt with the special status of which state/UT?
questions.explanation: Article 370 granted special autonomous status to Jammu and Kashmir, revoked in August 2019.

questions.question: In a K-map simplification, how many variables can be grouped in a single valid group?
questions.explanation: K-map groups must contain 1, 2, 4, 8... adjacent cells (powers of 2) to yield valid simplification.

questions.question: Which logic gate produces an output of 1 only when all inputs are 1?
questions.explanation: AND gate output is HIGH only when every input is HIGH.

questions.question: Which OS scheduling algorithm can cause starvation of low-priority processes?
questions.explanation: Pure priority scheduling can indefinitely delay low-priority processes if higher-priority ones keep arriving.

questions.question: What is thrashing in operating systems?
options: Excessive paging activity causing low CPU utilization
questions.explanation: Thrashing occurs when the system spends more time swapping pages than executing processes.

questions.question: In computer architecture, what does 'pipelining' primarily improve?
questions.explanation: Pipelining overlaps execution stages of successive instructions to increase throughput.

questions.question: Which data structure follows the Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle?
questions.explanation: A Stack operates on LIFO order where the last element inserted is the first removed.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree?
questions.explanation: A balanced BST has height log2(N), giving O(log N) worst-case search time.

questions.question: Which of these is a supervised machine learning technique commonly referenced under AI/IoT topics in the syllabus?
questions.explanation: Decision Trees use labeled training data, making them a supervised technique; the others listed are unsupervised.

questions.question: In the OSI model, which layer is responsible for routing packets between different networks?
questions.explanation: The Network Layer (Layer 3) handles logical addressing and routing across networks.

questions.question: Which SDLC model is best suited for projects with rapidly changing requirements?
questions.explanation: Agile's iterative sprints accommodate evolving requirements better than rigid sequential models.

questions.question: Which normal form removes transitive dependency on the primary key?
questions.explanation: Third Normal Form (3NF) requires that non-key attributes depend only on the primary key, eliminating transitive dependencies.

questions.question: Which protocol is used to assign IP addresses automatically to devices on a network?
questions.explanation: DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) automatically assigns IP addresses and network configuration.
